title: Insurance Claim Repairs Price List — Operations the Insurer Denied
content:
**Pricing clause.** A denied-operation addition to an Insurance Claim Repairs repair order is priced when its customer-pay addition consent is signed, from the most recently decided supplement on the repair order and the labor hours written on the consent. The price is the calibration price of the calibration order's tier when that supplement added sensor calibrations, plus the consent's labor hours times the body-shop hourly rate of **USD 104.00**, rounded to the cent.

## Price lines

| Line | Stated as | When |
|---|---|---|
| Calibration price | the calibration price of the tier of the ADAS Sensor Calibrations order opened for the repair order | only when the most recently decided supplement added sensor calibrations; otherwise there is no calibration line |
| Labor | the labor hours written on the consent multiplied by USD 104.00 per hour | always |
| Price | the calibration price and the labor added together, rounded to the cent | — |

**Which supplement.** The most recently decided supplement is the supplement whose insurer decision is the latest recorded on the repair order. Whether it added sensor calibrations is read from its submission record.

**Which calibration price.** The price belongs to the tier of the calibration order opened for the repair order under ADAS Sensor Calibrations; the figure is that tier's, not a figure of the repair class.

## Worked prices (hypothetical; the calibration price supposed at USD 400.00)

| Most recently decided supplement | Hours on the consent | Calibration price | Labor | Price |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| added sensor calibrations | 2.0 | USD 400.00 | 2.0 at USD 104.00, USD 208.00 | USD 608.00 |
| added no sensor calibrations | 2.0 | none | USD 208.00 | USD 208.00 |
| added sensor calibrations | 3.5 | USD 400.00 | USD 364.00 | USD 764.00 |

## Basis Q&A

**When is the price fixed?** When the customer-pay addition consent for the denied operations is signed.

**Is the calibration price charged if the supplement did not involve calibrations?** No. The calibration price enters the price only when that supplement added sensor calibrations.
